resources.string: Lend the phone for one call, not for everything else.
No permissions. No tracking. Ethic One Call never reads contacts, calls, messages or files.
1. Open Phone. 2. In Recents, choose Pin this app. 3. Hand over the phone. Android will require your PIN or fingerprint to leave Phone.
Enable screen pinning in Android Settings, then open Phone and pin it from Recents.
Phone opened. Pin it from Recents before handing over the phone.
